rules_text:
Rules summary Contents 1 OBJECTIVE 2 GAMEPLAY (per year) 3 ACTIONS 4 SCORING (after year 13) OBJECTIVE Lead your winery to success over 13 years (rounds). Collect points through produced wines, used resources, and a cleverly planned wine tour. GAMEPLAY (per year) Each player has a scoring sheet and 3 workers . A worker is available if their row is empty for the current year. Determine Region & Resource: The leader of the year determines which wine region (L, R, or E) and which resource (C, V, or T) is available to all players. Choose Actions: Everyone plays simultaneously. Per year, you can assign a maximum of one worker to Viticulture and one to Resources . Enter the letter of the action (e.g., "R" for Right Bank) 1, 2, or 3 times into the row of an available worker. Duration: More letters represent stronger actions (e.g., more valuable/aged wines) but block the worker for the following years. Passing: If a 3rd worker is available, they must pass (indicated by entering "-"). ACTIONS Make Wine: Circle a wine in the current region. Longer actions (RR instead of R) allow for more valuable wines. Connect the wine to your existing collection using paths. Gain Resources: Casks (C): Required to be able to produce certain types of wine. Vines (V): Fill the track from left to right. Filling certain spaces allows you to immediately circle a bonus wine for free. Trellises (T): Complete full rows to unlock permanent end-game bonus points (e.g., extra points per white wine). SCORING (after year 13) Add up your points from the following categories: Wine Tour: 1 point per completed path segment between your wines. Longest Tour: 3 bonus points for the longest continuous path. Casks: 1 point per used cask (+3 points for having used the most casks). Trellises: Points from the unlocked bonus rows. Leader Bonus: 1 point if you were the leader less often than others.

Players than pick a wine (e/l/r)/direction/strength (1-3) and circle it on their board, causing this color to take that many turn to reset, same with casks/vines/trellises. After 13 turns, the player with the most points wins, with end game points (trellises) and longest link of circled wins.
